item.title: Madison’s Rickert selected NW District Co-Coach of Year in Division III
item.description: MADISON TOWNSHIP — Doug Rickert worked his magic again. Madison’s Doug Rickert was selected the All-Northwest District Division III Coach of the Year. He shared the honor with Celina’s Bret Baucher.
